R263.note: Correct overflow-safe two-step bounds check (length then offset) before subspan(); throws on violation, no legitimate-path change.

R269.note: Replaces manual docmd() envelope commands with sendmail(); verified against CPython source that putcmd() rejects embedded CR/LF (ValueError), closing the injection; functionally equivalent message delivery.
